name: io.github.proappstore-online/platform
description: AI agent tools for ProAppStore (PAS), the Pro app marketplace: create and build Pro apps (direct file writes or the autonomous Agent Teams loop), provision and deploy, inspect deploys and D1 schema, author and run browser e2e flows, read the platform guide and SDK reference, and reach any published app's registered data tools. Per-app endpoints at https://mcp.proappstore.online/mcp/apps/<app_id> expose that app's own tools.

tools.name: list_apps

app_scoped_endpoints.note: Registers that app's mcp.json tools under their manifest names, plus whoami and mcp_audit_log. The shared /mcp endpoint never registers app tools; use list_app_tools then call_app_tool. Large manifests are exposed progressively (core tools resident, the rest via discover_tools / describe_tool).

io.github.proappstore-online/platform.dynamic_tools: The tools list above is the fixed shared set (src/tool-count.ts). App endpoints add per-app tools that vary by app and are not enumerated here.

safety.read_only_mode: MCP_READ_ONLY=1 blocks every mutating tool server-wide; reads and dry-runs still work
safety.audit: every mutating call, dry-run and read-only denial is recorded per user (90 days, secrets redacted); read it with mcp_audit_log
